title: Commentary: When stock analysts move markets, should retail investors follow?
snippet: Retail investors should be cautious about buying or selling shares simply because they read in the news that an analyst has changed a recommendation, says NTU finance professor Roger Loh.

title: From satellites to spaceports, Thailand seeks a bigger role in Asia's space race
snippet: Thailand is expanding its space ambitions, with plans for a launch facility and efforts to build a domestic satellite industry. But attracting investment and developing commercial demand remain major challenges, experts say.

title: Commentary: Permanent WFH is AI’s best promise yet
snippet: The AI optimists believe that machines will take all our jobs, but bots can create modern jobs too - jobs that resemble a pre-industrial notion of work, says Allison Schrager for Bloomberg Opinion.

title: Spanish transport minister offers resignation after deadly train crash
snippet: Spain’s Transport Minister Oscar Puente resigned and withdrew from the upcoming general election following a deadly train crash that killed 69 people.
